key_insight: Without external pretraining data, synthetic augmentation helps most when generated samples closely match real data and the real-only classifier has room to improve.
engineering_relevance: Evaluate generator–data mismatch and compare against traditional augmentation at matched optimizer steps before investing in synthetic training samples.
method: Train generators only on the classifier’s own training set.
Evaluate four classifier backbones and four generators across six datasets.
Bound excess risk by balancing distribution mismatch against increased training-set size.
evidence_signal: Across six datasets, including two medical datasets, larger estimated lower bounds on total variation distance were associated with less benefit on five datasets.
watch_item: The risk bound does not explain the magnitude of the largest gains, most of which traditional augmentation also achieves at matched optimizer steps.
paper_title: Generative Data Augmentation Without External Data: An Empirical and Theoretical Study on Deep Networks
